parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: EventSource
parameters.description:
The name of the event source.

*   This parameter is required if you query the system event bus.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eventbridge query-event --event-bus-name demo --event-id 1935debf-ddac-49dc-a090-d4f2857a046d --event-source testEventSourceName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eventbridge QueryEvent --region cn-hangzhou --EventBusName demo --EventSource testEventSourceName --EventId '1935debf-ddac-49dc-a090-d4f2857a046d'
